info.description: Opening title, order price, responsive pen imagery, and desktop animation.

edit.label: Headline
edit.description: Use a line break to place the second line underneath the first.

edit.label: Mobile image
edit.description: Portrait and phone layouts use this asset below 992 pixels.

edit.label: Desktop full pen profile
edit.description: Optional side-on image for the zoom-out when the desktop animation is disabled or unavailable. Choose a transparent image with proportions close to 896 × 141.

edit.label: Play desktop pen animation
edit.description: Turn off to show your desktop photo and full pen profile while scrolling.

edit.label: Desktop Lottie animation
edit.description: Upload a standalone Lottie JSON export with embedded images. Leave empty to use the original pen sequence.

edit.label: Alt text
edit.description: Use a short description of the image.
